admin.description: Groups allowed to administrate (create/delete) this destination.

read.description: Groups allowed to consume from this destination.

subject.description: Optional subject filter (not typically used in simple auth).

write.description: Groups allowed to produce to this destination.

password.description: User password (insecure; use JAAS for production).

broker_id.description: Unique identifier for the broker bean; used by Spring.

broker_name.description: Logical name of the broker (must be unique in a cluster).

delete_all_messages_on_startup.description: Delete all persisted messages on broker start (dangerous in production).

destination_policies.description: Per-destination policy rules (applied to matching patterns).

dead_letter_strategy.description: Reference to a DeadLetterStrategy bean ID (e.g., 'processExpired').

delayed_dispatch_checking.description: Enable delayed dispatch checking (for scheduled messages).

dispatch_policy.description: Reference to a DispatchPolicy bean ID (e.g., 'round-robin').

max_audit_messages.description: Max number of messages to track for deduplication/audit.

max_consumers_to_audit.description: Max number of consumers tracked for audit.

max_producers_to_audit.description: Max number of producers tracked for audit.

memory_limit.description: Memory limit for this destination (exceeded = producer flow control).

pause_producer_support.description: Enable pauseProducerSupport for slow consumer handling.

producer_flow_control.description: Enable producer flow control when memory limit is reached.

queue_pattern.description: JMS destination pattern for queues (supports wildcards: >, *).

connector_port.description: Port for the RMI registry (only used if createConnector=true).

create_connector.description: Whether to create an RMI connector server (for remote JMX).

jmx_domain_name.description: MBean domain name used to register broker MBeans.

network_connectors.description: List of broker network bridges to other ActiveMQ instances.

decrease_network_consumer_priority.description: Lower priority of network consumers to prefer local consumers.

dynamic_only.description: Only forward subscriptions created after connection start.

network_ttl.description: Number of nodes a message can traverse across the network.

prefetch_size.description: Message prefetch size for network consumers.

uri.description: URI of the remote broker (e.g., static:tcp://remote:61616).

jdbc_create_tables_on_startup.description: Create database tables automatically if missing.

jdbc_data_source_id.description: Bean ID of the JDBC DataSource to use (must be defined in config file as <bean>.

jdbc_lock_keep_period.description: Time (ms) between lock renewals in master/slave (JDBC).

jdbc_max_connections.description: Maximum JDBC connections in the pool.

kaha_checkpoint_lock_wait.description: Wait time (ms) for the checkpoint lock before failing (KahaDB).

kaha_directory.description: Directory for KahaDB files (must exist and be writable).

kaha_index_cache_size.description: Number of index entries cached in memory (KahaDB).

kaha_index_wire_format.description: KahaDB index wire format version (V1 or V2).

kaha_journal_max_file_length.description: Max size per journal file (KahaDB). Accepts suffixes: kb, mb, gb.

system_usage.description: Global memory, store, and temporary space limits.

memory_limit.description: Max memory for message buffering (messages exceeding this cause producer flow control).

store_limit.description: Max disk space for persistent messages (storeUsage).

temp_limit.description: Max disk space for non-persistent messages (tempUsage).

transport_connectors.description: List of transport connectors exposing client-facing ports.

discovery_uri.description: Discovery agent URI for auto-discovery (e.g., multicast://default).

enabled.description: Enable or disable this transport connector.

update_uris_url.description: URL to fetch updated transport URIs from (for dynamic discovery).

uri.description: Transport URI (e.g., tcp://0.0.0.0:61616). Supports options: wireFormat.*, transport.*, etc.

use_jmx.description: Enable JMX monitoring (required for ActiveMQ web console or external tools).

use_shutdown_hooks.description: Whether to register a JVM shutdown hook to gracefully stop the broker.
